Name: Fix Android 14 photo upload crash on backgrounding
Description: Fix NullPointerException in media picker callback when user backgrounds app mid-upload. Owner: Marcus. Repro steps: start a photo upload on Android 14, background the app before upload finishes, return to app. Expected: no crash. Acceptance criteria: crash no longer reproduces, crash rate for this issue drops to zero in reports, fix landed and ready for QA by Wednesday Aug 13. Related to mobile release on Aug 20.

Name: Verify Android 14 photo upload crash fix on test devices
Description: QA verification of the Android 14 photo upload crash fix. Owner: Sam. Steps: once Marcus lands the fix, add verification to regression run and test on Android 14 test devices using repro steps: start photo upload, background app mid-upload, return. Acceptance criteria: no crash observed, behavior matches expected upload resume/completion, test passes regression suite.

Name: Implement backend sync API for offline notes
Description: Build sync endpoint for notes offline mode. Owner: Elena. API should accept client last-synced timestamp and return delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Conflict resolution: last-write-wins for this sprint, no merge UI. Acceptance criteria: endpoint returns correct delta, handles edge cases, unit tests pass, PR created for review before Elena is out on 17th-18th.

Name: Implement client offline cache and sync for notes list
Description: Client-side offline support for notes list using Room local cache with write queue. Owner: Marcus. Requirements: local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, replay writes when connectivity returns. Acceptance criteria: app can be opened in airplane mode and notes are visible; notes can be edited offline; on reconnect, changes reconcile with backend with no data loss; works with backend sync API; ticket updated with acceptance criteria as discussed.

Name: Migrate CI pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions
Description: Replace Jenkins pipelines with GitHub Actions. Owner: Sam. Proof of concept for build job exists. This sprint finish test and release pipelines, keep nightly build schedule. Run Jenkins and GitHub Actions in parallel for one week before decommissioning Jenkins. Acceptance criteria: build, test, and release jobs run successfully in GitHub Actions, nightly schedule preserved, parallel run is clean for one week, Jenkins remains alive until sign-off.

Name: Implement per-user rate limiting for search endpoint
Description: Add rate limiting to search endpoint to prevent abuse. Owner: Elena. Requirements: 100 requests per minute per user, return HTTP 429 with Retry-After header when limit exceeded. Add metrics counter to identify users hitting limit. Acceptance criteria: limit enforced per user, correct 429 response with Retry-After, metrics exposed and visible, no impact to normal traffic.

Name: Update privacy consent screen for GDPR compliance
Description: Update consent screen for EU launch. Owner: Marcus. Legal flagged current screen non-compliant. Requirements: consent must be opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, no single pre-checked box, nothing pre-checked. Get new copy from legal and rebuild screen. Acceptance criteria: screen shows separate opt-in toggles for analytics and marketing, all toggles default off, consent recorded correctly, feature included in August 20 release as launch blocker.

Name: Add automated regression tests for payments flow
Description: Create automated test coverage for payments flow. Owner: Sam. Cover purchase, restore, cancellation, and receipt validation path. Acceptance criteria: tests pass locally, run as part of new GitHub Actions CI pipeline, provide regression coverage for payments flow to prevent recurrence of last release issue.
